analysis.insight_summary: Users are finding it challenging to convert integers to floats within the [product_name] system. Hardware and software restrictions prevent direct math operations with floats, resulting in workflow difficulties and user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward method to convert integers to floats and to use float values seamlessly in calculations with their [company_name] [product_name] system.
